latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of maker-free-google: Free Video Maker on Google

- Lets users create and export videos (MP4, 1080p) by uploading images/clips and describing the desired result.
- No downloads or subscriptions required; 100 free credits included.
- Automatic setup and authentication using a cloud backend (NEMO_TOKEN).
- Supports uploading common video, image, and audio formats (e.g., MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, MP3).
- Provides actions for uploading, editing, exporting, checking credits, and viewing status—all accessible by plain prompts.
- Returns finished videos in 1–2 minutes using a cloud GPU render pipeline.
